name: goriki
description: The decision post for a solo builder. One install registers the Goriki MCP server, the three session hooks, the escalation skill and the commands.

goriki_url.title: Goriki bridge address
goriki_url.description: The address of your Goriki bridge, copied from the Connect Agent screen. It ends in /mcp.

goriki_pat.title: Goriki project token
goriki_pat.description: The project token you minted on the Connect Agent screen. Sent as an Authorization header; this plugin never writes it into a file of its own.
